items.text: Steelers downgraded Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT (foot) for Sunday; was Q on ETR list after LP-DNP-DNP.
items.why: Foot injury; practice pattern poor, final downgrade Sat.
items.implication: PIT WR depth tested; Metcalf/others elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for DK Metcalf and remaining PIT receivers.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) biggest Q on slate, limited Fri after DNP Wed/Thu; impacts Herbert and LAC projections heavily; 4pm ET kick.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1; practiced limited Fri giving hope but uncertain.
items.implication: If OUT, Johnston/Harris target spike; Herbert ceiling hit.
items.opportunity: Quentin Johnston role expansion if McConkey inactive.

items.text: Nico Collins ruled OUT (hamstring) for Week 2 vs CIN after missing Thu/Fri practice; suffered in Wed practice with prior hammy history.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP Thu/Fri after limited Wed; history of multi-game absences.
items.implication: HOU WR room thin (Higgins ACL, Dell IR); volume to Boutte/Hutchinson/Noel/Schultz.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for remaining HOU pass-catchers; Schultz TE1 bump.

items.text: Zay Flowers DOUBTFUL (hamstring) for Week 2 vs NO; limited Fri after DNP Wed/Thu; Ja'Kobi Lane also OUT/IR.
items.why: Hamstring aggravation from Week 1; limited return Fri but not expected to play.
items.implication: BAL WR crumbs: Bateman/Walker/Wester primary; Andrews target bump possible.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes for BAL secondary WRs and TEs if OUT.

items.text: Brock Bowers DOUBTFUL (knee) for Week 2 at LAC after limited Fri return from meniscus cleanup; missed Week 1.
items.why: Knee surgery recovery; HC notes pregame workout, optimistic Week 3.
items.implication: Mayer or other LV TEs elevated; Jeanty already high util.
items.opportunity: TE volume redistribution in LV offense if inactive.

items.text: Joe Burrow good to go / listed Q (back) but said he's playing for Week 2 vs HOU; ETR notes expected IN.
items.why: Burrow self-reported playing; limited designations but positive.
items.implication: CIN offense full strength opposite Collins OUT; Chase/Higgins full.
items.opportunity: Normal Burrow usage; no backup QB risk.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) missed Friday practice, added to injury report ahead of MNF vs NYG; Donald plans to play.
items.why: Hip issue; DNP Fri; monitor Sat practice/final report.
items.implication: LAR WR1 risk for MNF; Adams/Kupp residual if limited/out.
items.opportunity: If limited/out, volume to other LAR WRs.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for 2026 debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown IR; potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson in good matchup stretch.
items.why: Ready to go; NE needs explosives; schedule favorable pre-bye.
items.implication: Committee or lead back potential; Stevenson handcuff/share risk.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes/touches expansion in NE backfield; goal-line/third-down mix.

items.text: AJ Brown OUT/IR (ankle/high-ankle sprain, multi-week) listed in Sunday injuries; NE WR room depleted.
items.implication: NE desperate for playmakers; Henderson debut timing perfect; remaining WRs elevated.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 24%+ tgt share (tied lead), 74% snaps/21-of-24 RB touches thru 3Q Week 1; IND gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 utilization + soft matchup; target share career-high range.
items.implication: RB1 upside weekly; massive season range if healthy.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry share in KC offense.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 Utilization Score Week 1 (tied Bijan lead); 19% tgt share recent; 25+ touches frequent.
items.why: Elite util under Kubiak; overreaction to prior injury scare.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8; CLE soft vs RBs.
items.why: Career-high target share + full RZ/ dual-threat role Week 1.
items.implication: RB1/flex smash; clear lead over Gainwell.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz Week 1; 93 yds/18 PPG career vs Wentz; CHI soft vs WRs.
items.why: Massive volume with Wentz; historical production + matchup.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share/routes with Wentz starting.

items.text: HATE Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: only 8% target share Week 1 (5th on team), zero RZ; SEA tough vs WRs.
items.conflict: Name value vs actual usage data.
